shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a yellow shirt sits in the counter-side aisle seat and poses a riddle, a woman in a purple shirt sits in the plant-side aisle seat, a woman in a red shirt sits in the plant-side window seat, and a woman in a green shirt sits in the counter-side window seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the café counter end, looking along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the floor plant in frame.

shots.content: The man in a yellow shirt and the woman in a purple shirt exchange seats; she claims that the riddle has a solution, and he questions the reasoning.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the window side, centered on the two adjacent aisle-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a yellow shirt asks about the date.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the rectangular table.
